config.primary_tau_frac_note: The registration states the anomaly at tau_frac 0.75 (the three-way spread-arm inversion) and 0.60 (doe at the maximum) but does not name the cell the decision is read at. 0.75 is declared primary here because it is the cell whose ranking the registration states; all four are reported with Holm across them. The choice is recorded rather than made after seeing the coefficients.

metric_status.alpha_star: MODEL-INTERNAL (a functional of the fitted posterior and nothing else)
metric_status.rule: A validated metric beats a model-internal one, and the disagreement is reported.
